adjudication.rationale: The new `ensure_embeddable` check requires `URI(request.referer || '').host == SiteSetting.embeddable_host` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb), which is an exact host match. This will reject legitimate embeds when the page is served from a common variant like `www.example.com` while the setting is `example.com`, and it also rejects cases where browsers omit the `Referer` header (the code turns nil into `''`, yielding `host == nil` and raising). This behavior is directly enforced by the diff and is likely to break embedding in real-world scenarios.
